top_stories.title: Microsoft is urging administrators to prioritise Entra ID over Active Directory
top_stories.summary: Microsoft is urging IT administrators to prioritize Microsoft Entra ID as the strategic identity platform for modern workloads over on-premises Active Directory. The recommended migration path is incremental, covering authentication, access decisions, and related identity functions.

top_stories.title: Microsoft is killing off SMS authentication codes as AI makes phishing attacks even more dangerous
top_stories.summary: Microsoft is ending SMS-based two-factor authentication for IT admin logins to Microsoft Entra ID accounts starting February 1. The change is part of Microsoft's broader push toward passkey adoption as a more secure authentication method.

top_stories.title: AWS IAM now provides role manager to set up IAM roles automatically
top_stories.summary: AWS has announced the general availability of role manager, a new capability within AWS IAM that automatically creates the IAM roles required by AWS services during console setup. The feature removes the need for manual role configuration when deploying supported AWS services, streamlining access management setup.

top_stories.title: Cyera's Oasis Security Buy Is All About AI Agent Control
top_stories.summary: Cyera acquired Oasis Security in a $1 billion deal to combine data security and identity management into a unified control plane. The deal redefines privileged access management around business context rather than static roles, with a focus on controlling AI agents.

top_stories.title: Belgium's eID Authentication Opens Citizen Accounts to RCE
top_stories.summary: Belgium's electronic ID (eID) authentication system was found to contain severe vulnerabilities in a key browser extension that fully compromised the trust framework underlying citizen account authentication. The flaws enabled remote code execution (RCE), exposing broader security risks associated with browser extensions used in authentication flows.

news.title: Weak IAM affects up to 98% of cloud environments
news.summary: A report by Intruder found that weak IAM configurations affect up to 98% of cloud environments, with misconfiguration identified as one of the leading threats. The findings cover issues such as unrotated keys, exposed services, and logging gaps across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, with CISA now mandating baseline cloud configuration practices for US federal agencies.

news.title: How Identity Drives MSP Profitability: An Analyst’s Perspective
news.summary: Cisco is promoting its Secure MSP Center and Duo platform as tools for managed service providers to deliver identity-first security to SMB and midmarket customers. The article frames identity management through Duo as a revenue driver for MSPs, focusing on reducing vendor sprawl and enabling recurring revenue streams.

news.title: Leading SAP GRC Tools: 2026
news.summary: The article reviews leading SAP GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance) tools for 2026, focusing on access control within SAP environments. The content covers tools that manage authorization and segregation of duties within SAP systems, which overlaps with identity governance and access management for SAP-specific use cases.

news.title: Microsoft 365 backup gap leaves customers responsible after ransomware
news.summary: Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and Azure services lack a guaranteed point-in-time data restoration commitment from Microsoft following ransomware attacks, leaving customers responsible for their own recovery. The article highlights that compromised identities enable attackers to corrupt or delete data, making independent immutable backups critical for protecting Entra ID configurations and identity data.

news.title: RISE with SAP and the SAP IDM Sunset: Two Deadlines, One Identity Strategy
news.summary: SAP Identity Management is approaching end of life, creating a dual deadline challenge for organizations also migrating to RISE with SAP. The article covers migration strategies, key risks, and planning considerations for identity governance during this transition.

news.title: Attackers Exploit SharePoint Authentication Bypass After Public PoC Release
news.summary: Threat actors are actively exploiting CVE-2026-55040, a critical Microsoft SharePoint authentication bypass vulnerability with a CVSS score of 9.1, following public release of proof-of-concept code. The flaw stems from weak authentication and was patched by Microsoft in the July 2026 Patch Tuesday updates.

news.title: The Customer Identity And Access Management Solutions Landscape, Q3 2026 Is Live
news.summary: Forrester has published its Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) Solutions Landscape report for Q3 2026. The report identifies three primary drivers shaping the CIAM market, including AI agents as a new identity type within CIAM platforms.

news.title: The Forrester Customer IAM (CIAM) Landscape Is Live
news.summary: Forrester has published its 2026 Customer Identity and Access Management (CIAM) Landscape report. The report identifies three primary drivers shaping the CIAM market, including AI agents as a new identity type within CIAM.

news.title: Azure IoT gets TLS 1.3, passwordless provisioning, and secure updates
news.summary: Microsoft is rolling out Azure IoT security updates including TLS 1.3 support for IoT Hub and managed-identity authentication between Device Provisioning Service and IoT Hub, currently in public preview. HTTPS downloads for Device Update is also being introduced alongside these changes.

news.title: Amazon S3 adds additional policy details to access denied error messages
news.summary: Amazon S3 has updated its HTTP 403 Access Denied error messages to include specific AWS IAM and AWS Organizations policy ARNs for same-account and same-organization requests. This enhancement helps administrators more quickly identify which policies are causing access denials during troubleshooting.

news.title: Keeper Security Issues Cybersecurity Guidance for Education IT Teams As Students Return to Campus
news.summary: Keeper Security released cybersecurity guidance targeting education IT teams for the back-to-school period. The guidance addresses AI-powered phishing, deepfake impersonations, and unmanaged machine identities in school and university environments.

news.title: Malicious LiteLLM Releases Tied to Trivy Hack May Have Exposed 2,100+ Organizations
news.summary: Two malicious LiteLLM releases containing credential-stealing code were published to PyPI for approximately 40 minutes in March, harvesting cloud keys, SSH keys, Kubernetes tokens, and database passwords from systems that installed them. A dataset of roughly 434,000 captured files indicates potential exposure across 2,100+ organizations.

news.title: How AWS IAM role manager rethinks the starting point for IAM roles
news.summary: AWS has introduced an IAM role manager tool that rethinks how developers create and manage IAM roles when building applications on Amazon Web Services. The tool aims to simplify the starting point for IAM role configuration, addressing the complexity of setting up permissions for AWS services acting on a user's behalf.

news.title: Gunra Ransomware Gang Exploits Fortinet Flaws, Bypasses MFA
news.summary: The Gunra ransomware gang is exploiting Fortinet vulnerabilities in firewalls and VPN appliances to breach critical infrastructure targets, using leaked Conti code. The attacks include bypassing MFA controls as part of their intrusion methodology.

news.title: Researchers Disclose AI-Assisted SharePoint Exploit Chain Reaching Unauthenticated RCE
news.summary: Security researchers disclosed an unauthenticated remote code execution exploit chain targeting Microsoft SharePoint Server, tracked as CVE-2026-55040 with a CVSS score of 9.1, affecting SharePoint Server Subscription Edition, 2019, and 2016. The vulnerability allows attackers to authenticate as any user, including administrators, without valid credentials, representing a complete authentication bypass.

news.title: Researchers Built a Fake Crypto Startup and Hired Three Suspected North Korean IT Workers
news.summary: Security researchers created a fake cryptocurrency startup and hired three suspected North Korean IT workers to study their methods, recording all activity on issued virtual machines. The investigation revealed identity fraud during onboarding, with one worker claiming a Texas address while providing a California driver's license and New York bank account.

news.title: Malicious MCP Servers Can Split Instructions to Make AI Coding Agents Exfiltrate Secrets
news.summary: Researchers have demonstrated that malicious Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers can manipulate AI coding assistants into exfiltrating secrets such as SSH keys and environment variables by splitting harmful instructions into innocuous-looking fragments. The attack bypasses safety refusals by distributing requests across multiple channels the AI agent already trusts, posing a credential and secrets theft risk relevant to IAM practitioners managing secrets and access controls.

news.title: 'GhostJacking' Exposes Identity Governance Gaps in AI Agents
news.summary: New research has identified an attack technique called "GhostJacking" that exploits identity governance gaps in AI agents by using security alerts and blocked events to manipulate and hijack them. The findings highlight weaknesses in how identity and authorization controls are applied to AI agents operating within enterprise environments.

news.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
news.summary: Canadian cybercriminal Connor Riley Moucka pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy charges for hacking and extorting over 165 organizations using Snowflake cloud storage. The attacks involved credential-based intrusions targeting Snowflake customer accounts, resulting in the theft of over 100 million AT&T customer records.

news.title: Lessons Learned from CISA’s Recent GitHub Leak
news.summary: CISA issued a postmortem report after a contractor accidentally exposed dozens of internal credentials, including AWS GovCloud keys, in a public GitHub repository for nearly six months. The incident highlights credential management failures and response gaps relevant to IAM and secrets management practices.

news.title: Scattered Spider Hackers Plead Guilty on Day 1 of Trial
news.summary: Two members of the Scattered Spider cybercrime group pleaded guilty in the UK to charges related to a 2024 cyberattack on Transport for London. Scattered Spider is known for sophisticated social engineering and identity-based attacks, including SIM swapping and MFA bypass techniques used to compromise enterprise systems.
